criteria.evidence: AES-GCM độc lập đã test nhưng chưa tích hợp SQLite hoặc external durable key ring; schema vẫn lưu tên và số tiền plaintext.
Chưa triển khai audit, giao dịch atomic hoặc purge.
Chưa có migration mới hoặc synthetic upgrader; Core 197 và Data 85 tests đã qua.
Chưa cập nhật ADR/schema/PLAN hoặc hoàn thành independent review.
Key ring va AES-GCM da test 3/3, nhung EF van map DisplayName va ba khoan tien plaintext; chua co bao ve SQLite.
Chua co audit coordinator, atomicity, normal delete hay purge.
Chua co migration moi hoac synthetic upgrader; Core 197/197 va Data 86/86 qua; HEAD va index khop baseline.
PLAN da ghi trang thai va roadmap 2.4; ADR, schema, development va independent review chua hoan tat.
Chua co migration 2.3 va copy-forward upgrader; Data tests 86/86 qua; bon migration cu co SHA256 khop baseline.
TaxManagerDbContext chua co audit coordinator, append-only guard, normal delete audit hay purge.
Da bo sung so do schema hien tai va vi du DB TEMP; ADR0015, implementation 2.3 va review doc lap chua hoan tat.
EF mapping UserProfileConfiguration, DependentConfiguration va MonthlyIncomeConfiguration van luu plaintext; chua co hydration/key-check. Data tests 86/86 chi kiem chung trang thai hien tai.

dotnet test tests/TaxManager.Data.Tests --no-build --no-restore --disable-build-servers -m:1: 135 passed, 0 failed/skipped (exit 0). Protection/ProtectedPersistenceTests.cs covers null/Unicode/decimal, reload/projection, field/row/profile/database swaps, missing/wrong keys and DB/WAL/audit/log markers; Protection/BackupRestoreTests.cs verifies BackupDatabase plus reopened external key ring. src/TaxManager.Data/Protection/ProtectionSession.cs:17 validates sentinel; mapped fields are BLOB only. ADR0015 documents metadata-only queries requiring explicit ValidateProtection, durable external key backup/rotation and recovery limits.

Data suite 135/135 exit 0 includes AuditBehaviorTests, AuditAtomicityTests, AuditRetryTests and WriteRequirementsTests: sync/async SQL/commit/cancel faults roll back; caller commit/rollback and preparation savepoint preserve earlier work; Save(false), no-op, stale/detached updates, SQLITE_BUSY, actual post-commit fault reconciliation and OperationId reuse tested. AuditSaveCoordinator.cs:17 writes business+encrypted audit through one base SaveChanges(false). ProfilePurgeService.cs:10 and cascade tests verify ordinary-delete retention, append-only guard, explicit purge and other-profile preservation. Actor is caller metadata, not authenticated.

Build TaxManager.sln exit 0; full Data 135/135 and Core 197/197, no skip, exit 0. dotnet ef migrations has-pending-model-changes --no-build reports no changes (exit 0). MigrationTests plus SyntheticUpgradeTests cover fresh/idempotent schema, populated direct upgrade rejection, exact synthetic copy/readback of all fields/PK/rules, FK/triggers, Down rejection and SQL/key/readback/cancel/publish failures preserving source. Four old migration/designer SHA256 values match baseline; HEAD remains c6418b2b2ddb86cac2e4b1c148b4ac8b2b77aca4; index SHA256 remains 3542A1D99B8922B88F7D28662498EC422D4C895E5AFFD5E14A7C14C10F87B84D. Only synthetic TEMP DB/key operations; bint task diff --all --stat shows task delta within allowed source/tests/docs/PLAN; git diff --check exit 0.

TSK1-11 implemented and checked; ADR0015, development guide, Mermaid schema and PLAN updated with actual 135 Data/197 Core results, crypto/metadata/key recovery, operation retry and deletion/purge boundaries. PLAN step2.4 specifies immutable input/result snapshots, RuleId+Version/provenance/engine version/UTC, encryption and deletion, without implementing2.4. Remaining TSK12 is configured independent Bint b-review: no independent review has yet run for2.3, so this combined criterion cannot honestly be marked met. Security manual review by user before any real-data use remains explicitly required. Review task-only delta using bint task diff --all with authorized TEMP object directory.

errors.message: Triển khai chưa hoàn tất: mới có primitive AES-GCM độc lập và hai test; chưa tích hợp persistence, audit, migration, nâng cấp hoặc tài liệu. Không sử dụng dữ liệu thật.
bint task diff --all that bai: git add tam khong ghi duoc .git/objects; HEAD va index sau do khop baseline. Thuc thi chua hoan tat: key ring chua ket noi EF, audit va migration chua trien khai.

Luot nay chi cap nhat tai lieu schema hien tai va duong dan database synthetic; chua trien khai EF encryption, audit, migration/upgrader. Khong co blocker ngoai duoc xac minh; can tiep tuc TSK-3 den TSK-12, khong coi la hoan tat.

Targeted 2.3 integration: 6/8 tests passed; decimal round-trip/update assertions passed but two raw storage assertions still referenced removed plaintext GrossIncome column. Updating those assertions to BLOB encrypted fields. EF scaffold raced with a slow first build and generated duplicate migration; removed only duplicate new files, retained one final migration.

Protected persistence 12/13 passed; Reload retained a locally edited unmapped amount when EF skipped assigning identical ciphertext. Fixing dirty notification and cache invalidation on tracker acceptance/reload; keeping the failing behavior assertion.
